limitations: No new hosted CI run, push, pull request or protection change.
Baseline transient PostgreSQL timeouts are retained; a single passing pooled run does not prove permanent elimination.
Loopback HTTP, tmpfs PostgreSQL, short waves and a shared Mac do not establish production SLOs.
Severe shortage remains FEASIBLE with unproven critical optimum.
Database connection count is an after-workload snapshot, not peak.
Create requests have no new automatic retry/idempotency contract.
